# FDGD056

> PERMITTED: Changing an `abstract` Member to `virtual`

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section D.11.20 Changing an abstract Member to virtual.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: draft

Every instantiable derived type already implements the member without a base call. PublicApiAnalyzers (optional in /fdg-setup) can flag changes to the public API.

## From the book

There is no runtime observable difference when you update a member from `abstract` to `virtual`. However, you should be aware that all instantiable derived types are already providing an implementation that does not invoke your member via a base member invocation.

The .NET BCL team considers this an acceptable change.
